name: quotaview
description: Writes sanitized Codex usage snapshots and activity events for the QuotaView macOS app.

interface.shortDescription: Private local Codex data bridge for QuotaView.
interface.longDescription: Uses official Codex read-only app-server methods to write a minimal usage snapshot plus sanitized lifecycle events. No prompts, commands, files, raw responses, account identifiers, or credentials are stored.
defaultPrompt: Explain what QuotaView Codex data stores.
